reasons.correctness: Currency.displayOrder is mapped to display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. CurrencyDtoOut gains displayOrder. Both mapping paths fill it: toDto through ModelMapper and getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos explicitly. The changeset seeds PLN first. Acceptance tests pass 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset follows the rules: correct path and name, formatted-sql header, rollback line, changelog include with a month comment. No new *UnitTest class was created; the tests went into the existing CurrencyServiceUnitTest.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal additive field. The agent propagated displayOrder into the existing hand-built CurrencyDtoOut builders in CurrencyController, PartnershipOpportunity and AppliedOpportunity, so all client responses carry it. It added no new mechanism. The five-way mapping duplication is pre-existing and the agent did not consolidate it.
reasons.test_quality: The Mockito tests pin displayOrder on toDto and on the paged mapping, with tuple assertions and constructor updates. They build the service through reflection on its protected constructor. They are placed in an existing class rather than a new *UnitTest.
reasons.graph_use: Before reading, the agent ran graph queries: currency files, the dependents of Currency and CurrencyDtoOut, and TESTED_BY links. It then found the other CurrencyDtoOut builders and changelog examples mostly through grep and directory listings.
